exposure: Profession (midwife/specialty trainee/doctor specialized in obstetrics and gynaecology)
outcome: Time interval between attending a specific obstetric event
cohort: Midwives, specialty trainees and doctors specialised in obstetrics and gynaecology working in hospital labor wards in Denmark (n=1625)
finding: Some obstetric events occur extremely rarely, hindering the ability to obtain and maintain the clinical skills to manage them through clinical practice alone.
